findings.description: The original remove() raised UnknownProduct when repository.delete(sku) returned False. The new code ignores the return value. If the row disappears between _fetch and delete (for example, a concurrent remove in another process), remove() reports success and _forget still runs, so callers no longer get the not-found signal they relied on.
findings.suggestion: Restore the check: if not self._repository.delete(sku): raise UnknownProduct(sku), and only call _forget after a successful delete.
findings.title: remove() no longer reports a failed delete
